Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for the productive demo last week. Legal has a few redline items on the SOW and we want to get a short, focused review with your procurement and engineering folks so we can close the loop on terms and confirm scope.

Attendees we think are essential: you and procurement lead (Priya), an Acuity engineer (for technical scope/ingress), our AE (Kimberly), SE (Marcus) and one legal representative from both sides. If the contract concerns require leadership, Vivek can join briefly.

Can you share 3 x 45-minute windows in the next 3 business days that work for Acuity? I attached a one‑page SOW draft to get ahead of redlines. Once you confirm times I’ll cascade invites and include a short meeting agenda.

Attachments: SOW-draft-acuity.docx (SOW v0.9)

Best,

Thanks for the proposed slot. I reviewed the SOW-draft-acuity.docx and the SE notes Marcus attached. To streamline the redline session we’ll:

2) Cover tech/security items only to the extent they affect obligations in the SOW (Marcus will speak to these).
3) Capture any follow-ups as tracked items and target a one-week turnaround on updated SOW.

I’ve prepared an annotated PDF (SOW annotated) and attached it to this thread for pre-read. If there are high-level liability asks from Acuity we should have Vivek join the first 10 minutes — I’ve cc’d him so he can confirm availability.

I’ll create the calendar event for Mon Apr 19 09:30–10:15 PT and include a short agenda + the pre-read. Tom / Priya — please confirm Jorge or another engineer is available; if not, reply with two alternate windows and we’ll pivot.
